shots.title: EXP-44: a hut made as a new building on the blank map (the squad starts at the lower left)

marks.text: the roof: the building's upper floor. It should hide when a soldier is inside, or the cursor is in the hut on the ground floor
the four walls: with the roof hidden they should cut down to low stubs, as a house's walls do
the swing door, on the far (east) wall: opens, a soldier walks through
the open freight door, on the north wall: a soldier walks in through it; it cuts down with the walls

shots.title: EXP-44: the hut from the north-east, the two doors in view

marks.text: inside, under the roof: two crates, a generator and a utility box. They show once the roof hides, give cover, and stay drawn (they are the ground floor's)
